title: About Me
description: Jianxiong Fan researches human–computer interaction, cognition, learning, and interaction design.
body:
I am Jianxiong Fan, a researcher interested in **human–computer interaction**, cognition, and interaction design. I hold a Master's degree in Design Studies, specialising in Digital Creative Design Research, and a Bachelor's degree in Digital Media Technology from [Guangdong University of Technology (GDUT)](https://english.gdut.edu.cn/).

My research examines **cognitive and emotional dynamics in human–computer interaction** through mixed methods. I combine quantitative user experience measurement and statistical analysis with qualitative inquiry to inform the design of products and service systems.

My recent work explores short-video entertainment-based learning for vocational training, with a focus on middle-aged and older adults with low educational attainment. I also study the cognitive, emotional, and behavioural mechanisms of interaction-based creative thinking. I am particularly interested in extending this work to **AI-supported learning and human–AI collaboration**.

skills.title: Research methods
skills.description: Mixed methods; field research and interviews; questionnaires; factor analysis; cluster analysis; structural equation modelling; think-aloud protocols; behavioural coding; lag sequential analysis.

skills.title: Experimental methods
skills.description: EEG/ERP, eye-tracking, and multichannel physiological recording.

skills.title: Design & prototyping
skills.description: Unity-based AR/VR interaction; Figma; Adobe Photoshop; Premiere Pro; Maya; 3ds Max.

interests.title: Human–computer interaction & human–AI collaboration
interests.description: Cognition, emotion, user experience, trust, and human agency, explored through mixed-methods research.

interests.title: Immersive interaction & creativity
interests.description: AR/VR experiences, digital cultural heritage, creative thinking, and human–AI co-creation.

interests.title: AI-supported learning & decision-making
interests.description: Entertainment-based learning and adaptive AI support for professional training and decision-making.
